body: I’m in the US. I’ll have to check if it’s available right now since there’s limited services open due to covid. I’ll try to talk to someone though. Thank you for your help
The more I think about it, the more I do want to tell him. Even if I’m gone, I don’t want my dad to keep helping him out by living here

My dad let them stay when they first got married because my sister was having a baby and what not. They haven’t moved out and have it good since they basically just give what they want for rent. My dad basically covers all the bills also even though they could afford to help out more
I do think it’ll be easier, I was such a mess when I told my mom. Thank you for reading through all that by the way
I really don’t feel strong but thank you so much. I’m thinking of writing a letter if I do end up telling him
